source_note: 黎曼积分的定义以及黎曼可积的判别
english_source_note: Riemann Integral and Criteria for Integrability
callout_id: 黎曼积分的定义以及黎曼可积的判别#9
english_title: Darboux Equivalent Condition for Riemann Integrability
statement_en: A function $f$ on the rectangle $I_{a,b}\subset \mathbb{R}^n$ is Riemann integrable if and only if for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a partition $P_{\varepsilon}$ such that $$\sum_{k=1}^{n_{\varepsilon}} (M_k-m_k)|I_k|<\varepsilon,$$ where $\{I_k\}_{k=1}^{n_{\varepsilon}}$ are the subrectangles induced by the partition $P_{\varepsilon}$, and $M_k,m_k$ are respectively the supremum and infimum of $f$ on $I_k$.
callout_body: 长方体$I_{a,b}\subset \mathbb{R}^n$上的函数$f$黎曼可积，等价于，对任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在划分$P_{\varepsilon}$从而使得$$\sum_{k=1}^{n_{\varepsilon}} (M_k-m_k)|I_k|$$其中$\{I_k\}_{k=1}^{n_{\varepsilon}}$是划分$P_{\varepsilon}$产生的子长方体（$\mathbb{R}$上的时候称之为区间，有时候为了方便都统一称之为区间），$M_k,m_k$分别是$I_k$上函数$f$的上确界和下确界。
